title: Metallic static complete-Wc projected Coulomb square root mixes head and body
symptom: The native RED test (src/test/test_rpa_headwing.cpp, +46 lines, job 3272953, 33 s) compiles and links but exits 255, throwing 'metallic static complete-Wc projected Coulomb square root mixes head and body'.
root_cause: In the metallic static complete-Wc path the head and body blocks of the projected Coulomb matrix are combined into one object before the square root is taken, so the square root is formed from a mixed head+body matrix instead of separate head and body blocks. The Wc projected-Coulomb square root therefore does not respect the head/body partition that the analytic head+wing treatment requires.
minimal_fix: Keep head and body as separate blocks when forming the square root of the projected Coulomb matrix in the complete-Wc metallic-static path; the RED assertion text defines the required behaviour (the method fix was still pending in the record).
validation: Re-run the pinned RED case after the method fix: it must still link and now exit 0 with all pre-existing assertions unchanged, and the ~33 s runtime envelope must not regress.
avoid: Do not treat head and body as one contiguous block for the square root, and do not delete or soften the 'mixes head and body' assertion to make the suite green.
